# Host names of cloud-model APIs. No string literal in a shipped Go file may
# contain one of these (AGENTS.md, non-negotiable 1). The match is a
# case-insensitive substring, so "bedrock-runtime" catches every AWS region.

# These live here, not in a Go file, so that the policy tests themselves hold
# no string literal naming a provider host. Text after "#" is a comment.
